name: Hollanda
isnote: Some analyses place it in Songlingornithidae; its relationships are uncertain (Bell et al. 2010; O'Connor et al. 2013).
sum: Long-legged ground bird from the Campanian Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia.
holotype: Partial hindlimbs from Khermeen Tsav (number in Bell et al. 2010).
biology: Its long legs and toe arrangement suggest a fast runner.
author: Bell et al. 2010
